card.name: Start of cancer names like HCC
card.fires_on: The first letter or piece of a cancer name or drug name, such as H in HNSCC or HCC, End in Endometrial, and Dec in Decitabine. It appears in oncology labeling next to tumor types.

modes.label: H in cancer abbreviations
modes.description: The letter H that begins HCC or HNSCC after a tumor list or 'patients with'.
modes.example: The incidence of new or worsening hypothyroidism was higher in 1185 patients with<< H>>NSCC, occurring in 16

modes.label: Start of long names
modes.description: The opening piece of endometrial or a drug name like decitabine.
